messages.text:
### 📋 LEGAL PRELIMINARY REPORT

#### 🏷️ CASE SUMMARY
* **Categories:** RAGGING, SEXUAL ASSAULT, PHYSICAL ASSAULT
* **Involved Party Type:** senior student

#### ⚖️ STATUTORY FRAMEWORK
**Governing Acts:**
* UGC (Promotion of Ragging Prevention) Regulations, 2009
* Anti-Ragging Act & National Anti-Ragging Rules
* Indian Penal Code (IPC) Sections 375-376 (Rape & Sexual Assault)
* Indian Penal Code (IPC)

**Key Legal Provisions:**
* **Section Central Government Prohibition of Ragging Bill, 1998** (Anti-Ragging Act, UGC Regulations): Definition and prohibition of ragging
* **Section 336-338** (Indian Penal Code): Act endangering life or personal safety
* **Section 341-348** (Indian Penal Code): Criminal force, wrongful restraint, confinement
* **Section 375-376** (Indian Penal Code): Rape and sexual assault
* **Section 3-7** (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012): If ragging involves children

#### 📝 ACTIONABLE PROCEDURES
1. Report immediately to college/institution anti-ragging committee
2. File written complaint with specific names, dates, and descriptions
3. Request protection measures before investigation
4. Simultaneously file police complaint if police intervention needed
5. File FIR under Anti-Ragging Act provisions
6. Collect medical certificates if physical injury occurred
7. Get witness statements from fellow students
8. Preserve evidence: messages, videos, photographs
9. Request interim protective measures (relocation, changed schedule)
10. File complaint with UGC Anti-Ragging Cell (ragging.uchd.ac.in)
11. Seek legal aid for representation
12. Request academic safeguards while complaint is pending
13. Escalate to principal/management if committee is biased
14. Contact National Human Rights Commission if state authorities unresponsive
15. Go to nearest police station or emergency services immediately
16. Report to female police officer if available (women can request this)
17. File FIR and get copy within 30 minutes
18. Do NOT bathe or change clothes before medical examination
19. Get medical examination at government hospital within 24 hours
20. Collect detailed medical report documenting injury, semen, DNA
21. Obtain photographs of all injuries
22. Provide complete statement to investigating officer
23. Inform police about any CCTV footage or witnesses
24. Request police to preserve all physical evidence
25. Apply for victim compensation under Victim Compensation Scheme
26. Request counseling support from NGOs
27. File anticipatory bail application if threatened by accused
28. Intimate court about threats or pressure to withdraw complaint
29. File First Information Report (FIR) at nearest police station
30. Provide detailed description of the assault incident
31. Mention date, time, location, and witnesses present
32. Get medical examination done immediately (within 24 hours ideally)
33. Collect medical certificates and photographs of injuries
34. File complaint before Magistrate if police refuses to file FIR
35. Preserve evidence (torn clothes, weapons used, etc.)
36. Get written FIR acknowledgement
37. Follow up with investigating officer regularly

#### 📞 CONTACT & SUPPORT
* Local Police Station
  📍 Jurisdiction of the educational institution
  ☎️ 112
  🔗 https://keralapolice.gov.in/

* UGC Anti-Ragging Helpline
  ℹ️ National helpline to report ragging incidents
  ☎️ 1800-180-5522
  🔗 https://www.antiragging.in

* College Anti-Ragging Committee
  ℹ️ Institution-level grievance redressal committee

* Women's Police Station / Special Cell
  📍 District police headquarters
  ☎️ 112
  🔗 https://www.keralapolice.gov.in

* Cyber Crime Cell (for online evidence)
  📍 District headquarters
  ☎️ 1930

* Women's Helpline
  ℹ️ 24x7 support for sexual assault victims
  ☎️ 181
  🔗 https://wcd.nic.in

* RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network equivalent)
  ℹ️ Confidential support for survivors
  ☎️ 9999911007
  🔗 https://www.aasra.info

* National Commission for Women
  ℹ️ Handles sexual assault complaints and investigations
  ☎️ 011-24363497
  🔗 https://ncw.nic.in

* Specialized Sexual Assault Units
  ℹ️ Dedicated units in district police for sexual crime investigations

* Local Police Station
  📍 Nearest police station in your jurisdiction
  ☎️ 112
  🔗 https://www.keralapolice.gov.in

* District Police Headquarters
  📍 District headquarters
  ☎️ 112

* National Emergency Helpline
  ℹ️ For immediate assistance in case of physical assault
  ☎️ 112
  🔗 https://www.emergencymanagement.in

* AASRA Helpline
  ℹ️ Emotional support for assault victims
  ☎️ 9820466726
  🔗 https://www.aasra.info

* National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
  ℹ️ Free legal aid for assault cases
  ☎️ 1800-180-7779
  🔗 https://nalsa.gov.in

* State Legal Aid Board
  ℹ️ Provides legal representation in assault cases

* Kollengode PS
  📍 Kollengode, Palakkad – 678506
  ☎️ 04923-262329
  🔗 https://maps.app.goo.gl/CGZ8btbn8xCGuQ4z5


---
**PROVISIONAL NEXT STEPS**: You are advised to consult with a registered legal practitioner or visit the nearest police station for formal proceedings.

laws.section: Central Government Prohibition of Ragging Bill, 1998
laws.title: Definition and prohibition of ragging
laws.description: Ragging is banned in all educational institutions. Various forms including physical abuse, psychological harassment, sexual abuse, and violations of dignity.

laws.title: Act endangering life or personal safety
laws.description: Rash or negligent acts endangering life. Punishment up to 3 months imprisonment and fine up to 250 rupees.

laws.title: Criminal force, wrongful restraint, confinement
laws.description: Unlawful restraint and confinement. Punishment ranging from 1 month to 1 year.

laws.title: Rape and sexual assault
laws.description: If ragging involves sexual abuse. Rigorous imprisonment of 7 years to life.

laws.act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
laws.title: If ragging involves children
laws.description: Punishment up to 5-10 years for sexual offences against children.

laws.title: Rape
laws.description: A man is said to commit 'rape' if he penetrates his penis into the vagina, mouth, anus or urethra of a woman or makes her do so, by coercion, abuse of authority or when she is incapable of giving consent.

laws.title: Punishment for rape
laws.description: Rigorous imprisonment of not less than 7 years but which may be for life, and also liable to fine and/or death penalty in case of aggravated rape.

laws.title: Rape by husband on wife during separation
laws.description: When a man commits rape on his wife who is living separate from him, he shall be punished with imprisonment of not less than 2 years.

laws.act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
laws.title: Punishment for penetrative sexual assault on a child
laws.description: For a child below 16 years: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 7 years and fine up to 1 lakh rupees. For 16-18 years: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 5 years.

laws.act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
laws.title: Punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault
laws.description: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years or life imprisonment and fine up to 1 lakh rupees.

laws.title: Disclosure of identity of victim of rape
laws.description: No information shall be published in any form which discloses or tends to disclose the identity of a victim of rape.

laws.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
laws.description: Whoever, except in the case provided by law, voluntarily causes hurt shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees, or with both.

laws.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by means of poison, etc.
laws.description: Whoever, except in the case provided by law, by means of poison or any harmful substance attempts to cause, or knowing that he is likely thereby to cause, hurt to any person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees, or with both.

laws.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
laws.description: Whoever, except in the case provided by law, voluntarily causes grievous hurt shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.

laws.title: Act endangering life or personal safety
laws.description: Whoever does any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine which may extend to two hundred and fifty rupees, or with both.

laws.title: Wrongful restraint
laws.description: Whoever wrongfully restrains any person shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one month, or with fine which may extend to two hundred and fifty rupees, or with both.

laws.title: Wrongful confinement
laws.description: Whoever wrongfully confines any person shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
